title: Need access to the Finance shared drive
body:
Hello, I started this week in Accounts Receivable and I need read access to the Finance shared drive (\\fs01\finance\Invoices) to look up customer invoices. When I click the mapped drive F: I get "You don't have permission to access this folder".

I can work on other things in the meantime but most of my onboarding tasks need this folder.

comments.author: Valeria Castro
comments.body: I'm Ignacio's manager, approved for read access to Invoices.
